scope: Activation component scheduling, lane precision, convex fusion, selective native sweeps
method: Manual review of the final transformations against the local standard; conservative fallback whenever a required certificate is unavailable

obligations: Distinguish a valid cyclic graph from unsupported analysis
Retain original activation identity, source order, SSA and snapshot dependencies
Use SCC identity only within the analyzed IR revision
transformations.implementation: The component queries are read-only. DAG-only APIs remain wrappers. Typed edges and separate original suspension events survive the query. ActivationOrder retains condensation successors and backward edges, including self edges.
transformations.fallback: Unsupported activation analysis cannot authorize mutation; a cyclic schedule cannot authorize a replacement union-wait process.

obligations: Intersect only independently sound value-dependence overapproximations
Retain address and control inputs
Group source-local overlapping stores, loads and old-value snapshots before narrowing cross-owner value edges
Split only proved single-lane publications with an exact source correspondence, bounded windows, and an independent observation/reordering certificate
Never split an atomic owner or narrow its original language-required sensitivity
transformations.implementation: Publication summaries retain identity source ranges. Cycle refinement intersects simplified slice reads with lane inputs. Window stores are reconstructed from the same source CFG. Physical local dependencies remain grouped. Language sensitivities remain separate from this value graph. Lane correspondence proves dependence rather than value equality; window emission retains the original computation and original SourceOwner provenance. Every cyclic SCC is refined independently of the first cycle witness; a genuine residual cycle cannot suppress precision in other SCCs. Per-store refinement attempts and bounded, single-use copy windows ensure termination without weakening any dependency certificate.
transformations.fallback: Unproved identity, mixed private writes, unsupported packed layout, more than 64 windows, failed slicing, or observable reordered transitions retain the existing execution path.

obligations: Admit each atomic member with the ordinary complete activation certificate
Retain all of its publications in one source-ordered slice with no windows
Require observational equivalence separately for every sliced owner
Reject a path that leaves a fusion and reenters through an external executor, including a previously accepted contraction
Keep timed continuations and event-region handoffs as boundaries rather than collapsing whole external processes
transformations.implementation: Atomic membership defaults to empty and is verified independently during materialization. Convexity is checked against the complete activation graph with effectful actors present. Conflicts are exclusion constraints rather than activation events. Resume/spawn and NBA/deferred staging remain boundaries. Plans contain attributes rather than operation pointers and are rechecked before replacement. A whole-design re-derivation rejects stale outside watchers or writers before any executable mutation, invalidating stale graph/effect/NBA proofs on fallback. Recovered sections must be connected within the selected graph and share the conservative external activity domain propagated through remaining owners; cyclic and excluded producers remain external event sources. This restricts costs only and does not replace any fusion certificate. The complete graph is traversed once for all domain labels.
transformations.fallback: Invalid, stale, nonconvex, incomplete or observer-incompatible plans leave the source actors intact.

obligations: Keep continuous-assignment and always_comb time-zero activations
Do not turn a process's read/write overlap into fixed-point iteration
Do not treat an activity domain as permission to activate a process
Preserve process rearm and latch retention
transformations.implementation: Original startup entries and pending bits remain authoritative in mixed regions. Self-dependent native owners remain outside pure computation groups. Explicit always_latch owners retain their executors. Union waits require a complete DAG and the existing activation/observation certificates.
transformations.fallback: Incomplete, self-dependent and unsupported owners retain their existing executors and watches.

obligations: Propagate external and feedback activity only through forward dependencies
Consume readiness before executing each original member
Execute forward publications within a finite sweep and preserve backward publications for another sweep
Keep coordinator handoffs and termination polling between sweeps
Require a separate lowered nontrapping/effect proof before speculative pure execution, including LLVM poison obligations
Keep initial/task pre-wait prefixes distinct from resumed runtime-owned fragments
transformations.implementation: Native ordering includes analysis-only runtime boundary nodes, which cannot enter ABI owner tables or execution groups. Original timed continuations remain separate. Per-node activity seeds propagate through forward edges within and between SCCs; every backward edge seeds its actual destination rather than activating the entire SCC. Repeatability-certified blocks may coarsen external activity to a union of pending bits only under the unchanged lowered nontrapping/effect proof. Runtime sources and terminal observers move only across topologically independent components; an external A-to-B-to-C boundary stays between the computations. Existing readiness, promotion, handoff, termination, and forward-publication postdominance checks remain mandatory. Initial and one-shot runtime fragments are never collapsed into a repeating activation. Known repeating owners share an existing ready owner only when the frozen graph proves their repeating shape; conservative additional boundaries do not authorize extra execution.
transformations.fallback: Uncertified members use actual pending-event guards and their existing four-state executor. No new runtime ABI or worker/VPI eligibility is introduced.

obligations: Detect actual expression transitions using both four-state planes
Retain X/Z posedge and negedge behavior
Keep knownness eligibility independent of activation eligibility
Do not remove observable intermediate publications such as 0-to-1-to-0
transformations.implementation: Transition lowering is unchanged. Per-member promotion predicates remain independent of activity. Mixed blocks do not share an all-or-nothing execution domain with an unrelated incompatible component. Publication elision still requires the destination to execute afterward and the observation certificate to hold.
transformations.fallback: Unknown values, external observation and unproved speculation retain exact four-state publication and pending-event execution.

obligations: Capture NBA values and targets at evaluation time
Preserve ordered NBA updates and subsequent Active work
Keep generated-clock and foreign-call handoffs
Do not move updates across event-region boundaries
transformations.implementation: The changes do not alter NBA staging or commit executors. External NBA publications are activity inputs after the existing barrier. Clock readers retain their original watch events. Clocked work retains exact-edge cohorts and guarded execution. Scalar clock producers and their upstream scalar publication inputs remain executor boundaries as a cost restriction; complete single-scalar-input/output inventories cross noncandidate transport actors. This covers complements without inferring value equality and preserves transport shapes used by tick-bound and static-NBA proofs.
transformations.fallback: NBA, deferred-region and foreign effects retain their existing executor and coordinator protocol.

obligations: Associate pending assertion and unique/priority reports with the original process
Flush only at that process's actual resume points
Preserve Observed, Reactive and Postponed maturation
transformations.implementation: Report operations are not pure fusion members. Their original executors, process identities, report queues and handoff points remain in place. Activity masks do not create report-process resumptions.
transformations.fallback: Any report or unsupported effect prevents raw-body grouping and replacement union-wait fusion.

validation.focused_runtime: 162 focused tests pass on the final compiler. Both source/native component modes assert feedback=4, acyclic=2, retries=2 and termination at O0/O3; all 32 cone outputs are observed. The clock-proof MLIR test retains facts across fusion, complements and an Always boundary. The new lane-refinement MLIR regression checks both false-cycle patterns after a genuine cycle, separately and together.
validation.full_suite: Final check-talos passed: 5,699 tests, 62 expected failures, 24 unsupported. The 162 focused tests also pass independently after the full suite.
validation.performance: All six gates pass across five sequential CPU7-pinned uninstrumented runs. BP: 17.6086s to 12.4563s (-29.2600%), 94.4731G to 89.4194G instructions (-5.3494%); full stdout/stderr, UART, signature and final time 292724000 match. RSD: all 8 program outputs match, instructions/simulated-cycle +0.1027%, median wall +0.0608%. Separate BP diagnostic builds record 117488090 to 80822494 computation-block entries (-31.2079%). Final BP retains 350 per-site NBA latch slots. Compile time, peak RSS, binary size, profiling, reference comparison and retry-counter limitations are recorded in docs/activation-component-performance.json.
validation.independent_review: Complete. Independent correctness, test-coverage and MLIR/LLVM reviews approved the final code. A fresh review found and verified correction of global lane-refinement early exit; the new MLIR regression failed on the old compiler and passes after correction. The final evidence review independently verified all 44 runtime records, 144 output hashes, raw perf counters, medians and gates, compiler/binary SHAs, diagnostic counters and QEMU totals, self-profiles, Verilator reference runs and regression logs. No blocking findings remain.
validation.broader_o3_fusion: Enabled automatically in the production O3 pipeline after all semantic,regression,performance and independent-review gates passed. The component-sections pass option still defaults off for explicit pipelines.
